easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Reckless Fireweaver to indefinitely gain all creature types including Pirate.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers at least once.
Resolve a Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
